derivation: from H410 (אֵל) and H1008 (בֵּית־אֵל); the God of Bethel;
def: El-Bethel, the title given to a consecrated spot by Jacob

occurrences.text: And he built there an altar, and called the place El–beth–el: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
